description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Skirk Prospector, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
